atlas-29.label: First Union flag — royal maritime design
atlas-29.note: Modern rendering of the first Union design. Introduced for sea use in 1606 and reserved to royal ships in 1634; restored in 1660 and retained for Great Britain in 1707. The Interregnum and the 1801 redesign are excluded. It does not imply uniform local flags across all colonies; early shades and proportions varied.

map-united-kingdom.label: Union flag of Great Britain
map-united-kingdom.note: Modern rendering of the first Union design, retained for the Kingdom of Great Britain in 1707 and replaced in 1801. This source record uses the later label “United Kingdom” for the earlier British polity and some dependencies. Local colonial flags were not uniform; this is the Crown’s Union flag, not proof of a particular local flag.
